cells.gaps: No source found since November 2023 says a court case management system is in service in any court. Lawyers file written submissions online through the e-Service Platform, which counts only once case management is shown in service.
cells.note: The Judiciary launched phase one of its e-Service Platform in November 2025, the first of a phased digital rollout (SYC-003), so an e-justice system is being built. Online filing (SYC-001) cannot count while no case management system is shown in service.
